source.title: Blizzard official Hotfixes: April 17, 2026 (historical dated entries)
source.author: Blizzard Entertainment

quote: Blossoming Rootwarden's Focus should now disenchant into Midnight materials.
notes: Official March 18, 2026 Items hotfix entry, not publication date of the running article. Exact gear base item 259349 independently named in Wowhead. This is a stated wrong-expansion DE output fix; the earlier original March 10 and March 18 firsthand reports in midnight/2026-11-18T1018 are historical and cannot be pooled into present-day Midnight material yields. Applies to named gear only, no proven at-cast item level/bonus, armor/weapon extrapolation, skill, specific resulting output IDs, casts, hits, zeros or histogram. Statement is expected behavior, not an original client test.
affects: Blossoming Rootwarden's Focus (item 259349); correct Midnight-versus-The War Within material expansion
wording: Blossoming Rootwarden's Focus should now disenchant into Midnight materials.

source.title: Blizzard official Hotfixes: April 17, 2026 (historical dated entries)
source.author: Blizzard Entertainment

quote: Gear obtained at levels 10-79 disenchants into The War Within materials.
notes: March 13, 2026 Items hotfix for gear from NEWLY created Crate of Battlefield Goods. Levels 10-79 are the character LEVEL AT GEAR ACQUISITION, NOT equipment item-level or disenchanting profession skill. Official wording. Do not apply to preexisting crates or all gear from all sources. This and row 1303 describe complementary bands of ONE hotfix, not two independent material-yield studies. Not a 272246 level/ilvl lookup, no output IDs/casts/histogram given.
affects: Newly created Crate of Battlefield Goods gear (crate family; exact per-tier item IDs unspecified); level obtained 10-79, The War Within enchanting materials
wording: Gear obtained at levels 10-79 disenchants into The War Within materials.

quote: Gear obtained at levels 80-90 disenchants into Midnight materials.
notes: Companion character-level acquisition band in the SAME March 13, 2026 Blizzard Crate of Battlefield Goods hotfix as row 1302, not independent denominator. Applies to NEWLY created crates; not gear itemLevel 80-90, not a general rule for all items or scaled Miststalker's Wristbands. Crate of Battlefield Goods has item 135539, but multiple tiers exist and the official hotfix does NOT identify exact tier item IDs; no inferred mapping of 135539 specifically to high-level tiers. No completed original DE operation, stack, rank, or material ID.
affects: Newly created Crate of Battlefield Goods gear (crate family; exact per-tier item IDs unspecified); level obtained 80-90, Midnight enchanting materials
